about: Fixed questions for the voice questionnaire (contract §2.2), in the voice of the diagrams: oblique, few words, never therapeutic. `opening` is always the first question (wording fixed by contract §2.2.2 / §8.2). `reask` is used once if the opening gets silence. `probes` are used in order when next_turn times out or fails, or when the orchestrator must ask but the turn said compose (fewer than 2 answered). Each probe lands on one ground of contract §2.3 and aims at one thing the score needs: 1 time (-> diagram), 2 time + intention (-> trajectory), 3 body (-> mirror), 4 others (-> position). None names a diagram, a position or an emotion; all <= 25 words.

en.opening: What nameless feeling is your heart carrying at the moment?
en.reask: No hurry. What is here with you?
probes: By tonight, what should be left of it?
Where does it live, in the body?

es.opening: ¿Qué sentimiento sin nombre lleva tu corazón en este momento?
probes: Para esta noche, ¿qué debería quedar de eso?

fr.opening: Quel sentiment sans nom votre cœur porte-t-il en ce moment ?
fr.reask: Sans hâte. Qu'est-ce qui est là, avec vous ?
probes: D'ici ce soir, que devrait-il en rester ?
Où cela vit-il, dans le corps ?

pt.opening: Que sentimento sem nome o seu coração carrega neste momento?
pt.reask: Sem pressa. O que está aqui com você?
probes: Até esta noite, o que deveria sobrar disso?
